parts.gloss: to leave or auxiliary of certainty

literal: Beforehand without guarding, he who neglected, his own mistake, afterwards [when] harm [comes], having regretted, will end up.
translation: One who fails to guard himself beforehand and acts with negligence will surely end up lamenting his mistake later when ruin strikes.
modern: முன்கூட்டியே தன்னைக் காத்துக் கொள்ளாமல் சோம்பலால் தவறியவன், பின்னர் துன்பம் வரும்போது தன் பிழையை நினைத்து வருந்துவான்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the danger of negligence and the importance of foresight. The word 'முன்னுற' means 'beforehand', emphasizing that precautions must be taken before danger arrives. 'இழுக்கியான்' refers to a person who slips or fails due to forgetfulness or carelessness. When such a person does not guard themselves in advance, they will inevitably face harm ('ஊறு') later. At that point, they can only lament their own mistake ('தன்பிழை'), but it will be too late to avert the consequences.
